title: All In Zero
description: This is a large-scale adventure mod for Minecraft in China.
body:
This is a large-scale adventure mod for Minecraft in China. The author plans to add four dimensions, several types of blocks, ores, as well as items, tools, and weapons and armors.  
You can find a variety of new ores and use them to craft extremely powerful weapons, tools, and equipment. Before version 1.0.0, this mod is in the snapshot and beta test versions. The content volume is quite limited, but it can still be played normally. You can also join the author's Discord channel to offer some suggestions or assist with the development, such as submitting the textures of some items and blocks.  
The Discord channel of the mod: https://discord.gg/hd8sTShCDs.
